# Hector

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Last P28](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Hector possesses the finest looks and has lovely, dark, curly hair.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)_

## Personality

Hector is an honorable young man who possesses a pleasant disposition.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)_

## History

Hector accompanied [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), and [Orlando](../character/orlando.md) during Nell's enjoyable stay at [Mount Holly](../codex/places.md#mount-holly). He later visited [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) to deliver the news to [Thora](../character/thora.md) that John Fairlie's mother was dying.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cressy-lindsay--hector.md)

Hector and [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) share a romantic connection, with Hector pursuing her as a courting interest by Volume 3. He spends time in her company during a stay at [Mount Holly](../codex/places.md#mount-holly) alongside [Orlando](../character/orlando.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Their developing romance places [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) among the close social circle Hector interacts with during these travels.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), +2 more_
